cards.name: Surskit
cards.description: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

cards.name: Genesect
cards.description: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.description: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Dusknoir
cards.description: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.description: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.description: Thought to be an embodiment of the sun, it appeared during a bitterly cold winter and saved Pokémon from freezing.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.description: It shelters itself in its shell then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.description: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.description: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.description: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.description: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.

cards.name: Masquerain
cards.description: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.description: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.description: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.

cards.name: Glalie
cards.description: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Froslass
cards.description: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

cards.name: Relicanth
cards.description: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

cards.name: Snover
cards.description: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.description: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.

cards.name: Tirtouga
cards.description: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. It swam skillfully and dove to depths beyond half a mile.

cards.name: Carracosta
cards.description: It could knock out a foe with a slap from one of its developed front appendages and chew it up, shell or bones and all.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.description: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

cards.name: Lileep
cards.description: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.description: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.description: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.description: It latches on to prey with its sucker mouth, sinking in its fangs and shocking the prey with powerful electricity.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.description: These Pokémon are called the "Signpost for Wandering Spirits." Children holding them sometimes vanish.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.description: They carry people and Pokémon, but the wind can catch them, so there can't be a fixed destination.

cards.name: Uxie
cards.description: When Uxie flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.

cards.name: Mesprit
cards.description: When Mesprit flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.

cards.name: Azelf
cards.description: When Azelf flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.

cards.name: Munna
cards.description: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

cards.name: Cradily
cards.description: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.

cards.name: Musharna
cards.description: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.description: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.

cards.name: Solosis
cards.description: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.

cards.name: Duosion
cards.description: When their two divided brains think the same thoughts, their psychic power is maximized.

cards.name: Reuniclus
cards.description: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. They can crush boulders psychically.

cards.name: Golett
cards.description: Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon from clay. It's been active for thousands of years.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.description: Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon. They run on a mysterious energy.

cards.name: Machop
cards.description: Though small in stature, it is powerful enough to easily heft and throw a number of Geodude at once.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.description: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.description: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.description: It flies by flapping its broad leaves and gives the sweet, delicious fruit around its neck to children.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.description: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.

cards.name: Throh
cards.description: When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.

cards.name: Sawk
cards.description: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.

cards.name: Archen
cards.description: It was revived from an ancient fossil. Not able to fly, it lived in treetops and hopped from one branch to another.

cards.name: Archeops
cards.description: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.description: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.description: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

cards.name: Aron
cards.description: In order to build up its steel body, it eats iron ore. This pesky Pokémon is known to eat railroad tracks.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.description: Lairon fight over territory, and when their steel bodies collide, sparks fly.

cards.name: Aggron
cards.description: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.

cards.name: Karrablast
cards.description: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.

cards.name: Escavalier
cards.description: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.description: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

cards.name: Shelgon
cards.description: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

cards.name: Salamence
cards.description: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.

cards.name: Axew
cards.description: Its large tusks have a tendency to break, but each time they grow back, they grow in harder and sturdier.

cards.name: Fraxure
cards.description: A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

cards.name: Haxorus
cards.description: Its tusks are incredibly destructive. They can easily slice through a thick, sturdy steel column every time.

cards.name: Shelmet
cards.description: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.description: It runs through the narrow tunnels formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.description: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby play only when it feels safe.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.description: A man-made Pokémon created using advanced scientific means. It can move freely in cyberspace.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.description: It was upgraded to enable the exploration of other planets. However, it failed to measure up.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.description: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.description: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.description: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.description: Its tongue is just like a human's. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.

cards.name: Accelgor
cards.description: When its body dries out, it weakens. So it wraps a membrane around itself for protection while it spits poison.
